svg.title: 01-converged-silicon
svg.desc: Convergence strategy illustrated without a numerical residual plot. At fixed interaction strength g, alternate the self-energy Σ and Green function G until self-consistency. If g is below one, increase g and use the previous solution as the next initializer, then repeat the same SCBA cycle. At full strength g=1 a qualified self-consistent solution is the target. This is a workflow illustration, not a reconstructed iteration trace or evidence that every fitted-model run converged. The separate qualified NEP g1 result and all original saved histories remain in the source records. The original left panel, all72 actual Si positions, periodic-cell boundaries and the2.72nm interaction /4.89nm full-device dimensions are preserved.

g.aria-label: 72 silicon input positions, 4.89 nanometre device, 2.72 nanometre selected interaction region
g.title: Silicon calculation input: 9 conventional cells
g.desc: Exact input fractional positions projected orthographically; a=5.43356003 angstrom, [100] transport. Transverse directions are periodic. Dashed layer boundaries mark the conventional-cell repeat. Atom positions are not jittered. Lengths span cell boundaries.
